source: estimate: the fixed-point engine counted on an rv32im model (tools/cpu), scaled by one measurement on the FM-1

calibration.method: 303 Acid of M1-0.2 (b907693), one note held, peak cycles per block = 12 % of 2902 us (the ISR peak measured on the FM-1)
calibration.benchNote: firmware/src/bench.c kernels (4x Q15 MAC 9 us, Q15 SVF 8 us per block, rounded down) give the same scale within a few %
calibration.note: module kits hold note 72; a square or saw oscillator costs more the higher it plays
